dataset: PB2002 plate boundary model (Bird, 2003) – GeoJSON conversion (fraxen/tectonicplates)
description: Boundaries between the 52 tectonic plates of Peter Bird's PB2002 digital model, as line segments labelled with the two adjoining plates and whether the segment is a subduction zone.

coverage.temporal: Static scientific model published in 2003 (boundaries digitised 1987–2002); converted to GeoJSON in 2014

updateCadence.upstream: Static; the repository changes very rarely

attribution: Plate boundaries: Bird, P. (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochem. Geophys. Geosyst., 4(3), 1027, doi:10.1029/2001GC000252. GeoJSON conversion by Hugo Ahlenius, Nordpil (github.com/fraxen/tectonicplates), ODC-By 1.0

license.name: Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By) v1.0
license.notes: The repository README and LICENSE.md state: "This collection is made available under the Open Data Commons Attribution License" and ask that Hugo Ahlenius, Nordpil and Peter Bird be credited. (It is ODC-By, not the public-domain ODC PDDL.) The underlying model is from Bird (2003), G-cubed, doi:10.1029/2001GC000252.

limitations: A scientific model from 2003, not an observation: boundary positions are interpretations, many plate boundaries are in reality broad deformation zones (Bird's 'orogens') rather than sharp lines, and offshore segments are accurate to tens of kilometres at best.
Only the boundary type 'subduction' is flagged in this conversion; ridges, transforms and other classes of the original model are not distinguished.
Segments that cross the 180° meridian were split by the converter; a few segments are duplicated in the file.
Proximity to a plate boundary says nothing by itself about current seismic or volcanic hazard.
confidenceNotes: No per-record confidence is published. Peer-reviewed global model (Bird 2003); each segment carries the name of the publication or digitisation it was taken from.

retention.note: Reference data: a segment is kept for as long as the published file lists it.

layers.name: Tectonic plate boundaries
layers.description: Plate boundary segments of the PB2002 model (Bird 2003), labelled with the adjoining plates; subduction zones are marked.
